D: A dad struggles to let go as his daughter plans her wedding with an over-the-top planner.
P: Serve the hot dogs when George loses it over the buns.
S: Franks in toasted buns with fried onions, mustard, relish and cheddar

Eight grilled frankfurts in exactly eight toasted buns, with sweet fried onions, mustard, relish and a little grated cheddar. Slowly fry 2 sliced onions in 20g butter for 15 minutes until golden. Simmer 8 frankfurts for 5 minutes, then grill 2 minutes for colour. Toast 8 hot dog buns, no more and no less. Fill each with a frankfurt, the onions, a squeeze of mustard, a spoon of relish and a sprinkle of 80g grated cheddar.
Warm blinis with lemon crème fraîche and smoked salmon

Warm blinis with crème fraîche, smoked salmon, capers, red onion and dill, fancy bites for meeting the very rich in-laws. Warm 16 cocktail blinis at 180C for 4 minutes. Mix 150g crème fraîche with the zest of 1 lemon and a pinch of salt. Top each blini with a spoon of crème fraîche, a ribbon of smoked salmon from 150g, 2 capers and a sliver of red onion. Finish with a dill sprig and cracked pepper and serve with lemon wedges.
M: Seared chicken breast in tarragon cream sauce, potatoes and beans

Pan-roasted chicken breast with a creamy tarragon, white wine and mustard sauce, crispy potatoes and buttered green beans. Roast 800g halved baby potatoes in oil at 220C for 35 minutes. Season 4 chicken breasts with the skin on and sear skin-side down in a hot pan for 5 minutes, flip and roast at 200C for 12 minutes. Rest. Fry 1 diced shallot in the pan, add 100ml white wine and reduce, then 200ml cream, 1 tsp Dijon and 1 tbsp chopped tarragon and simmer 2 minutes. Serve with the potatoes and 300g buttered beans.
W: Lemon cake layers, lemon curd and buttercream, edible flowers

Two layers of lemon butter cake filled with lemon curd and covered in silky white vanilla buttercream, decorated with fresh flowers. Beat 200g butter and 200g caster sugar, add 4 eggs and the zest of 2 lemons, then fold in 250g self-raising flour and 100ml milk. Bake in two lined 20cm tins at 180C for 25 minutes. Cool. Sandwich with 150g lemon curd. Beat 200g butter with 400g icing sugar, 2 tbsp milk and 1 tsp vanilla until white and fluffy and spread over. Decorate with edible flowers.
K: Vanilla ice cream, milk and malted milk powder blended thick

Thick vanilla malted milkshakes with a drizzle of caramel and whipped cream, the kind you'd make after midnight in the kitchen. Chill 4 glasses in the freezer for 15 minutes. Blend 600ml cold milk, 8 scoops vanilla ice cream, 4 tbsp malted milk powder and 1 tsp vanilla until thick. Drizzle caramel sauce down the insides of the glasses, pour in the shake and top with whipped cream from 150ml thickened cream and a sprinkle of malt.
